title: n8n-cli all-in-one configuration (.n8nctlrc.json)
description: All-in-one configuration for n8n-cli. Place as .n8nctlrc.json in the project directory (discovered by walking up) or as config.json under $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/n8nctl/ (default ~/.config/n8nctl/config.json). Project settings win over user settings; environment variables and CLI flags win over both. String values support ${ENV_VAR} interpolation; referencing an undefined variable is an error.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema for editor support.

apiKey.description: n8n API key. Prefer "${ENV_VAR}" interpolation over a literal value; a literal key in a project-level file triggers a warning.

timeout.description: Request timeout, e.g. "30s", "5m" or plain milliseconds (env: N8N_API_TIMEOUT, flag: --timeout).

lint.description: Lint configuration. Same shape as the legacy .n8nlintrc.json, nested under this section.

rules.description: Rule configs keyed by rule name. Values: true/false, "error"/"warning"/"off", or ["error"|"warning", { options }].

projects.description: Per-project rule overrides keyed by n8n project ID.

client.description: Client middleware chain, e.g. ["iap-auth", "api-key-inject"] (env: N8N_CLIENT_MIDDLEWARES, proxy flag: --client-middleware).

server.description: Server middleware chain, e.g. ["lint", "authz"] (env: N8N_SERVER_MIDDLEWARES, proxy flag: --server-middleware).

options.description: Per-middleware options keyed by middleware name. Keys mirror the camelCase CLI flag names of each middleware. Secret values must come from env-var references.

proxy.description: Defaults for the `proxy` command. CLI flags and environment variables override these.

upstream.description: Upstream n8n base URL. Falls back to api.url when omitted (env: N8N_API_URL, flag: --upstream).

logIdentity.description: Include caller identity (email) in log lines (flag: --log-identity).

allowDuplicates.description: Skip the upstream duplicate-name check on workflow creation (flag: --allow-duplicates).

serverMiddlewares.description: Proxy-scoped server middleware chain. Takes precedence over middlewares.server for the proxy command.

clientMiddlewares.description: Proxy-scoped client middleware chain. Takes precedence over middlewares.client for the proxy command.

routes.description: Route table lines, same format as --routes.

duplicateTtlMs.description: TTL (ms) for the cached upstream workflow-name index (flag: --duplicate-ttl).

upstreamTimeoutMs.description: Per-request upstream timeout in ms; 0 disables (flag: --upstream-timeout).

mcp.description: MCP gate policy applied to n8n's instance-level MCP endpoint (flag family: --mcp-*). The gate stays off unless enforce is set — a policy without enforce makes the proxy refuse to start, mirroring the orphan-policy check on the flags.

allowTools.description: Glob patterns for the only tools clients may see (flag: --mcp-allow-tools).

denyTools.description: Glob patterns for tools to withhold, applied after allowTools (flag: --mcp-deny-tools).

workflowTags.description: Workflow tags required for workflow-scoped tool calls, AND condition (flag: --mcp-workflow-tags).

entryPathPattern.description: Entry-trigger path glob a workflow must match (flag: --mcp-entry-path-pattern).

cacheTtlMs.description: Cached workflow allowlist lifetime in ms (flag: --mcp-cache-ttl-ms).

mcp.description: Client-side MCP settings, used by `import` to read workflow folder assignments (the public REST API cannot report them). Distinct from `proxy.mcp`, which configures the proxy's MCP gate.

mode.description: off (default): never call MCP. direct: the CLI holds the MCP access token itself. proxy: the CLI holds no token - an n8n-cli proxy in front of n8n injects one for /mcp-server/*.

token.description: MCP access token. Supports ${ENV_VAR} interpolation (flag: --mcp-token, env: N8N_MCP_TOKEN).

strict.description: Fail the command when MCP calls fail, instead of degrading to a warning (flag: --mcp-strict).
